brief:
Settlers set fire to a vehicle and painted slogans in an area east of al-Samou in the southern West Bank city of Hebron, the Ma'an news agency reported. The incident is part of an ongoing pattern of attacks by Israeli settlers in the occupied Palestinian territories.

The specific content of the slogans and the extent of damage to the vehicle were not immediately detailed. Settler violence in the Hebron area has intensified in recent years, with residents frequently reporting property damage and intimidation.
title: Settlers torch vehicle, spray graffiti east of al-Samou in Hebron
